quote: For relief of the signs and symptoms of bursitis
note: Single-ingredient naproxen labels list bursitis directly.

quote: Treatment of glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis
note: Single-ingredient alendronate label covers glucocorticoid-induced (corticosteroid-induced) osteoporosis.

quote: Gastrointestinal Infections caused by Salmonella typhi (typhoid fever)
note: Single-ingredient ampicillin label lists typhoid fever.

quote: in the treatment of the symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease (paralysis agitans), postencephalitic parkinsonism
note: Single-ingredient carbidopa (Lodosyn) label names postencephalitic parkinsonism, used with levodopa.

quote: in the treatment or prevention of various types of euthyroid goiters, including thyroid nodules, subacute or chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis (Hashimoto’s), multinodular goiter
note: Goiter appears only on thyroid (T4+T3) combination labels where TSH suppression is attributable to levothyroxine itself; note single-ingredient labels exclude nontoxic diffuse goiter in iodine-sufficient patients.

quote: control of ventricular rate at rest and during stress in patients with chronic atrial flutter and/or atrial fibrillation
note: Single-ingredient verapamil label lists atrial flutter.

quote: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
note: Single-ingredient nivolumab (Opdivo) label covers NSCLC.

quote: Herpes zoster ophthalmicus
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label lists herpes zoster ophthalmicus.

quote: congenital or acquired hypothyroidism
note: Single-ingredient liothyronine label covers congenital hypothyroidism.

quote: in anaphylaxis as an adjunct to epinephrine and other standard measures
note: Single-ingredient diphenhydramine injection lists anaphylaxis (adjunct).

quote: Ankylosing spondylitis
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label lists ankylosing spondylitis, a subtype of spondylitis.

quote: Edematous States To induce a diuresis or remission of proteinuria in the nephrotic syndrome
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone label lists edematous states.

quote: rashes due to poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac
note: Single-ingredient topical diphenhydramine labels list poison ivy rash.

quote: Tobramycin for Injection is indicated for the treatment of bone infections caused by susceptible isolates
note: Single-ingredient tobramycin label covers bone infections, i.e. osteomyelitis.

quote: seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS)
note: Single-ingredient topiramate label lists LGS.

quote: adjunctive therapy for the treatment of acute hyperammonemia and associated encephalopathy
note: Only label is sodium phenylacetate/sodium benzoate, where benzoate is itself a co-active nitrogen-binding agent, so the indication is attributable to benzoic acid.

quote: Rheumatic fever and/or chorea —Prophylaxis with penicillin G benzathine has proven effective
note: Single-ingredient penicillin G label covers rheumatic fever prophylaxis.

quote: fulminating or disseminated pulmonary tuberculosis when used concurrently with appropriate antituberculous chemotherapy
note: Single-ingredient prednisolone label lists pulmonary tuberculosis (adjunct).

quote: indicated for the treatment of conjunctivitis and other superficial ocular infections
note: Single-ingredient sulfacetamide label lists conjunctivitis.

quote: superficial punctate keratitis
note: Single-ingredient loteprednol label lists superficial punctate keratitis, matching punctate epithelial keratoconjunctivitis.

quote: generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP)
note: CIDP appears only on efgartigimod/hyaluronidase (Vyvgart Hytrulo), where hyaluronidase is just a dispersion enzyme so the indication belongs to efgartigimod.

quote: Lower Respiratory Tract Infections , including pneumonia and bronchitis
note: Single-ingredient aztreonam label lists bronchitis.

quote: serious intra-abdominal infections including peritonitis
note: Single-ingredient clindamycin label lists peritonitis.

quote: secondary amenorrhea and abnormal uterine bleeding due to hormonal imbalance
note: Single-ingredient medroxyprogesterone label lists abnormal uterine bleeding.

quote: Reduce the risk of myocardial infarction
note: Single-ingredient atorvastatin label covers MI risk reduction.

quote: help restore normal serum potassium levels in patients who develop hypokalemia on the kaliuretic diuretic
note: Single-ingredient amiloride label covers hypokalemia (potassium deficiency).

quote: Temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies: o runny nose o sneezing
note: Single-ingredient diphenhydramine label covers hay fever (allergic rhinitis).

quote: Prophylaxis of malaria
note: Single-ingredient doxycycline label lists malaria prophylaxis.

quote: Severe acute and chronic allergic and inflammatory processes involving the eye and its adnexa such as
note: Ocular cicatricial pemphigoid is not named but falls under the single-ingredient hydrocortisone ophthalmic inflammatory category; the combination text plays no role.

quote: Lymphogranuloma venereum caused by Chlamydia trachomatis
note: Single-ingredient doxycycline label lists LGV.

quote: maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
note: Single-ingredient tiotropium label lists COPD.

quote: Post-traumatic osteoarthritis Synovitis of osteoarthritis
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone label lists osteoarthritis indications.

quote: indicated in the management of hypertension either as the sole therapeutic agent
note: Single-ingredient chlorthalidone label lists hypertension.

quote: Allergic conjunctivitis.
note: Single-ingredient corticotropin label lists allergic conjunctivitis, of which atopic conjunctivitis is a subtype.

quote: idiopathic bronchiolitis obliterans with organizing pneumonia
note: Single-ingredient prednisone label lists a bronchiolitis subtype.

quote: temporarily relieves nasal congestion due to the common cold, hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies
note: Single-ingredient pseudoephedrine label covers upper respiratory nasal symptoms.

quote: acute and subacute bursitis
note: Found only on betamethasone sodium phosphate/betamethasone acetate (Celestone Soluspan), where both ingredients are betamethasone, so it is attributable to the drug.

quote: NOVOLIN R is indicated to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients with diabetes mellitus
note: Single-ingredient human insulin labels cover diabetes mellitus, including type 1.

quote: Prophylaxis of repetitive paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
note: Single-ingredient verapamil label lists PSVT.

quote: as an adjunct to diet to reduce TG levels in adult patients with severe (≥ 500 mg/dL) hypertriglyceridemia
note: Single-ingredient icosapent ethyl label lists hypertriglyceridemia.

quote: congenital or acquired hypothyroidism
note: Single-ingredient levothyroxine label covers congenital hypothyroidism.

quote: partial onset or primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures
note: Occipital lobe epilepsy is a focal (partial-onset) epilepsy covered by single-ingredient topiramate labels.

quote: Nosocomial pneumonia in adult and pediatric patients 2 months of age and older
note: Only label is piperacillin/tazobactam, where piperacillin is the antibacterial and tazobactam the beta-lactamase inhibitor, so respiratory infection is attributable to piperacillin.

quote: indicated in adults for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic
note: Single-ingredient oxycodone covers severe pain generally, including CRPS pain; the combination text is not needed.

quote: herpes zoster keratitis
note: Single-ingredient loteprednol label lists herpes zoster keratitis.

quote: ZEPATIER ® is indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) genotype 1 or 4 infection
note: Only label is elbasvir/grazoprevir, where grazoprevir is an HCV NS3/4A protease inhibitor that actively contributes to the HCV indication.

quote: acute gouty arthritis; acute rheumatic carditis; ankylosing spondylitis; psoriatic arthritis; rheumatoid arthritis
note: Found only on betamethasone sodium phosphate/acetate labels, where both ingredients are betamethasone, so it is attributable to the drug.

quote: indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic
note: Single-ingredient buprenorphine covers severe persistent pain generally, including facial pain; the combination text is not needed.

quote: blastomycosis, coccidioidomycosis, histoplasmosis, chromomycosis, and paracoccidioidomycosis
note: Single-ingredient ketoconazole label lists coccidioidomycosis.

quote: Actinomycosis caused by Actinomyces species
note: Single-ingredient tetracycline label lists actinomycosis.
